answer.reason: Acts 18 tells what Apollos did in Ephesus and how Aquila and Priscilla taught him, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: taught diligently the things of the Lord, though he knew only John's baptism
clauses.quote: he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord

clauses.english: was taken aside by Aquila and Priscilla and taught the way of God more perfectly
clauses.quote: expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly

doubts: The 'planted, watered' saying in 1CO 3:6 is a figure of speech, so I did not use it as an event.
1CO 16:12 and TIT 3:13 only mention his travel plans, so I left them out.
